chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub, from al-Husayn ibn Muhammad, from Ahmad ibn Ishaq, from Sa'dan ibn Muslim, from Abi Basir, from Abi 'Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:
It is appropriate for the one afflicted by a bereavement not to wear his cloak, and to remain in a shirt, so that he may be recognized.

key_terms.صَاحِبِ الْمُصِيبَةِ: the person affected by a calamity or bereavement
key_terms.يَلْبَسَ: to wear or put on clothing

ai.seo_question: What does a hadith from Tahdhib al-Ahkam say about how a bereaved person should dress?
ai.summary: This hadith gives an etiquette-related ruling for a person struck by a bereavement. It indicates that the bereaved should appear in a recognizable state of mourning by not wearing the outer cloak and instead remaining in a shirt.
